message:
The other day, I found myself rummaging through the attic and stumbled upon some old board games from when my kids were little. It took me back to those evenings filled with laughter and friendly competition, completely unplugged from screens. It made me think about how much joy those simple moments brought us, and how they could be a wonderful part of our family emergency plans too. 

In times of uncertainty, having a stash of low-tech fun can really lift spirits and bring us together. Have you rediscovered any old favorites lately?
